text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower, the wagashi you gave me yesterday 
was also very delicious.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I usually can’t talk much about wagashi with 
the others... so being able to share impressions 
like this is really fun ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but if I recommend them too much, I might get 
fat...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. Any excess calories consumed can simply be 
burned off with exercise after eating.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your current weight is still within the proper 
range. There’s no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I actually bought some new wagashi... would you like 
to eat them together?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Operation ‘Sweets,’ let us carry it out 
without fail.
